# Rōmy

> Rōmy helps small nonprofits find new major donors at a fraction of the cost of existing solutions.

Rōmy is a donor intelligence platform built for small nonprofit teams. It uses AI-powered prospect research to surface wealth indicators, giving histories, and affinity signals — then distills them into actionable donor profiles.

## Features

- Donor Discovery: AI-powered prospect research with wealth indicators, giving history, and affinity signals
- Fraction of the Cost: No enterprise contracts or per-seat licensing — donor intelligence at a price built for small nonprofits
- Ready to Act On: Every prospect comes with connection points, giving capacity, and outreach angles

## Research and benchmarks

- [PIF-Bench: Benchmarking AI Donor Research](https://getromy.app/labs/blog/benchmarking-ai-prospect-research): Ground-truth benchmark comparing Rōmy, Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini on donor prospect research accuracy.
- [How We Built a Donor Intelligence Engine Starting at $0.10 per Prospect](https://getromy.app/blog/how-we-built-donor-intelligence): Unit-economics breakdown of AI-powered wealth screening at a fraction of enterprise pricing.
- [What Actually Predicts Giving Capacity — and How Rōmy Scores It](https://getromy.app/blog/understanding-wealth-indicators): The scoring framework Rōmy uses to separate giving capacity from inclination.

## Field notes and industry perspective

- [The Small Nonprofit Fundraising Gap — and How to Close It](https://getromy.app/blog/small-nonprofit-fundraising-gap): Why organizations under $2M in budget are priced out of traditional wealth-screening tools.
- [Major Gifts Aren't a Wealth Problem. They're a Timing Problem.](https://getromy.app/blog/major-gifts-are-a-timing-problem): Capacity gets a prospect on the list; timing wins the gift.
- [Capacity Scores Are the Astrology of Fundraising](https://getromy.app/blog/capacity-scores-are-the-astrology-of-fundraising): Where wealth-capacity models help, where they mislead, and what to do about it.
- [Your CRM Is a Haunted Spreadsheet](https://getromy.app/blog/your-crm-is-a-haunted-spreadsheet): On donor context that dies in the CRM, and bringing a stale file back to life.

See https://getromy.app/blog and https://getromy.app/labs for the full archive.
